content.thinking: `env -i` cleared PATH so `/usr/bin/env python3` failed. Let me use the absolute python3 path with env -i.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && PY=$(command -v python3); echo "PY=$PY"; env -i "$PY" /app/submission/bridge.py < /app/examples/scenario.json > out.json 2>err.txt; echo "rc=$? stderr_bytes=$(wc -c < err.txt)"; "$PY" -c "
import json
a=json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/out.json')); b=json.load(open('/app/examples/expected.json'))
print('match:', a==b)
d=open('/workspace/tmp/out.json','rb').read()
print('trailing newline:', d.endswith(b'\n'), 'single line:', d.count(b'\n')==1)
"; cat err.txt
